facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: energy isolation failure on SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-4100 and TX-3002 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on SG-4100 and TX-3002 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 29 June 2018 an incident occurred on SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
